name: weildbuild-server
description: WeildBuild platform servers: Main Server (REST API + orchestration), Realtime (presence/chat), Game Host (game instances). Deploys to Render, database on Neon. v1.9.2: GUEST MODE - POST /api/auth {action:guest} creates an ephemeral Guest-NNNN account (random unguessable password, is_guest flag). Guests can join game instances and open profiles, but restricted routes reject them (publish/buy/avatar/friends/DMs/profile settings/votes - the gamehost also drops their in-game chat). Signing out purges the account and every trace of it; an hourly sweeper reaps abandoned guests after 24h. New column users.is_guest, added automatically by the boot-time prisma db push. v1.9.1: the Vote page - admins post update ideas (POST /api/votes), every player votes anonymous Yes/No thumbs (POST /api/votes/vote, one vote per player per idea, toggle on/off; the API only ever returns counts + your own vote). New vote_ideas + vote_votes tables, added automatically by the boot-time prisma db push. v1.9.0: admin role commands (/admin, remove admin, remove ban via /admin/moderate make_admin|remove_admin, top admin only), announcements (POST /admin/announce: letters to one/many/all players with instant Realtime push + inbox copy, notification titles), Notification.title + User.notifyToasts columns, and the shop catalog re-names (Gold Torso, Navy Blue). v1.8.1: any https://*.vercel.app origin is allowed (CORS + origin validation).
//: BUILD FIX v1.2.0: prisma, typescript, tsx and @types/* live in dependencies ON PURPOSE. Render builds run with NODE_ENV=production, and npm silently skips devDependencies in that mode — that is what broke the v1.1 deploy (TS7016: no declaration file for 'express'). Do NOT move them back to devDependencies.

scripts.setup: npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.test:all: npm run test:wbworld && npm run test:world-runtime && npm run test:compat && tsx tests/test-netcode-e2e.ts
